patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Amplemarket share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans data-enrichment, contact-management; Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Amplemarket share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants..
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record..

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted..

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Amplemarket's motion (AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
